department: Department of Computer Science and Engineering (J. B. Speed School of Engineering)

deadline.value: No PhD deadline appears on the fetched Speed School or catalog pages; ask the department.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are required for the PhD; the catalog says successful applicants typically have a combined Verbal and Quantitative score of 295 or above.
gre_general.quote: Results from the Graduate Record Examination (GRE)

gre_subject.value: Computer science has no subject GRE and the catalog does not mention one.

supervisor.value: The catalog does not say whether a faculty member must agree before admission.

funding.value: Qualifying doctoral students may be awarded a $22,000 fellowship per year plus full tuition and health insurance; awards are selected, not automatic.
funding.quote: If you are a qualifying doctoral-level student, you may be awarded fellowships worth $22,000 per year, plus full tuition and health insurance

also.quote: Upon admission, students are automatically considered for fellowships. No additional application is required.

entry_route.value: Normally a master's comes first, but a qualified applicant can enter directly after a bachelor's with extra coursework.
entry_route.quote: Normally, it is expected that the student will complete a master's degree before being admitted to the PhD Program

english_waiver.value: A degree from an acceptable English-language institution can replace the test, but the catalog does not say whether an Indian university qualifies, so ask the department.
english_waiver.quote: demonstration of a degree awarded from an acceptable English language institution

notes: Source: the 2026-27 graduate catalog CSE PhD section and Speed School graduate admissions and funding pages. Speed School fees ($65) match the Graduate School. The catalog's 'typically TOEFL 79' is not a minimum, so the Graduate School's TOEFL rule is inherited.
